scenario: Same fact set produces same rule firing order on every run per LDET.3.1. Three rules on three distinct trigger values fire in source-declaration order (deterministic): ra fires first, rb second, rc third. NOTE: the three asserts ARRIVE in the same order the rules are declared, so completion order and source order coincide and either model passes — this fixture cannot tell them apart. What it does pin is its own clause, [LDET.3.1]: the same fact set gives the same order on every run, which holds under either. LDET.5.4.completion.json is the one that discriminates.
rules_ds:
schema A scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule ra:
    A a where a.v == 1
->
    log info "ra"

rule rb:
    A a where a.v == 2
->
    log info "rb"

rule rc:
    A a where a.v == 3
->
    log info "rc"
